about: (2026-11-17, pipefix: "from" 20 -> 10. The mod turns the camera on at match frame from x 60 (logic.c qa_frame) and the match clock runs 30 a second, so 20 held it from the match's 40th second -- about 45 s into the run, the last 15 s only -- and qa_checks --from 22 read mostly the game's moving cameras (qa084: "the still camera did not take hold"). With 10: still from the match's 20th second, about 25 s into the run; run the checks --from 27.) visualfix 2026-11-15, the user's playtest item 1: 'the Nitro logo on the background banners flickers'. MONDAY NITRO's stage set has two steel plates (Revenge t03) with the red WCW Monday Nitro logo (t11) on them, both at z 2216 (one plane). A CPU match; from 20 s the scenario's own camera, still, on the aisle looking at the back of the stage (the plates at x +-232..368, y 136..464), so nothing in the top half moves -- shots every 0.25 s. A tie in depth is a mottle of the two pictures (steel showing through the logo in patches), still while the camera is; it moves when the camera does. Checks: qa_checks.py hf <run> <twin's run> --from 22 -- the top half's fine grain under 0.85 x the twin's (vf_nitro_banners_old, WCW_NATIVE_PLANES=0: the layers as before, the negative control); qa_checks.py flicker <run> --from 22 -- nothing flips between shots. LOOK: the red logos whole on their plates in every shot; then the game's own cameras (the first 20 s): no shimmer on the banners.
